mentions.note: Belgrave team that won the 1954 A.A.A. 4 x 110yds relay, Birmingham, 42.6 (club record)
club record list: SENIOR MEN 4 x 100m Relay 42.6
won 1953 Club Championships 100yds in 10.2, equalling Championship Best; rejoined the Club 1993

photos.c: It's August 1st 1953 and the Club Championships are being held at Battersea Park. Basil Walden (2) takes the 100yds title, equalling the Championship Best of 10.2, with Denis Merrett (1) 2nd in the same time and Ron Holtum (4) 3rd. Basil rejoined the Club this year and of course Dudley Gordon (7) has never ever left us.
